_comment: The fleet's addressable nouns. One entry per thing that can be up or down.
Every entry carries provenance: where and when it was MEASURED.
SCHEMA RULE enforced at load (matzav_probe.load_registry): a unit whose only
probe is 'systemd' is REJECTED. Declared state is not real state.
Sacred units get their stop verb ERASED at load time by Gate 1.
